name: Lastlight Keeper Interior — Reference Gate B
review_note: The complete room reads from above as an inhabited keeper's home: bed, pillow and blanket, three-drawer dresser, low blanket chest, full bookshelf with individually colored books, desk and ledger, chart table, weather instrument, crockery shelf, framed windows and paired lanterns occupy distinct usable zones.
verdict: PASS — all reference furnishing families are present and deliberately placed
improve: The pictured characters remain runtime actors. Future narrative pickups can populate the ledger without altering the accepted furniture layout.
